caption:
Six days until Battle of the Tech Bands Sydney, and Bandlassian are back after winning last year's crowd vote.

Atlassian's band opened their 2025 set with two Toto songs back to back. This is the second, Rosanna, from the Factory Theatre. They had the biggest line-up of the night. See what they bring to Manning Bar on Thursday 8 October.
